item.title: Four injured in accident near Lehavim
item.description:
A man in his 40s and a 23-year-old woman were moderately injured in a collision between two vehicles on Highway 31 near Lehavim. Two other people sustained minor injuries.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams treated the injured at the scene before evacuating them to Soroka Hospital in Be'er Sheva.

item.title: Report: Israel blocking construction of Gaza base for Board of Peace
item.description: Israel has reportedly blocked construction of a Gaza military outpost for Trump's Board of Peace, delaying deployment of international troops and reconstruction.

item.title: Car of Elad mayor's chief of staff catches fire, no injuries reported
item.description:
Police reported that the car belonging to the chief of staff of the mayor of Elad caught fire. No injuries were reported.
The incident occurred shortly after a grenade was thrown at the home of the municipality's director-general.

item.title: Trump: If Iran had a nuclear weapon, they would use it within 24 hours
item.description: President Trump predicts the Iran war will end soon, claims Tehran would use nuclear weapons if it had them, and suggests further US military action remains possible.

item.title: Voting begins at Israeli diplomatic missions worldwide
item.description:
Voting at Israeli diplomatic missions around the world has begun with the opening of the polling station at Israel's embassy in New Zealand.
Israeli diplomats worldwide will cast their ballots over the next 24 hours.

item.title: Watch: US forces destroy Iranian surveillance vessel targeting navy ships
item.description: CENTCOM says US forces destroyed an Iranian-linked vessel targeting American warships in the Gulf of Oman, as Washington continues enforcing its naval blockade.

item.title: Extremist protesters attempt to storm IDF building near Bnei Brak, two arrested
item.description: Violent clashes erupt near Bnei Brak as dozens of extremist protesters attempt to force their way into a building housing an IDF unit responsible for integrating haredi soldiers.

item.description: New parliamentary caucuses in Athens and Nicosia aim to strengthen Israel's strategic partnerships in the Eastern Mediterranean, promote security and energy cooperation, and counter antisemitism and regional threats.

item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu and Foreign Minister Sa’ar welcome opening of Colombia’s embassy in Jerusalem and hail strengthening of relations between Israel and Latin America.

item.title: Exclusive interview: The rabbi's decision that saved an IDF officer's life on October 7
item.description: A day before completing 12 years of military service, Major Y. received an urgent call to report to the Gaza Division headquarters. His community's rabbi urged him to stay and defend his neighbors instead.

item.description: Contradicting a report published by The Atlantic last month, Kan News reveals that two businessmen, not Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel, were aboard the Egyptian aircraft that landed in Israel 11 days before the October 7 massacre.
